trickyParts: Keeper buckets are an explicit list per program (WithKeptBuckets), not discovered: each program's NATS grant covers only its own buckets, and the listener's stores open buckets through their own JetStream contexts on client.Conn. A listed bucket not created yet (CI bucket without a GitHub route, redelivery bucket without an App key) is skipped silently.
The keeper never touches subjects, age, duplicate window or discard: two releases with different subject lists would otherwise switch the stream each period.
